name: Sample Dev
subject: Application for the Position of Integration Developer
paragraphs: I am writing to apply for the Integration Developer position at Meridian Integration Partners. Over the past four years I have worked as a backend software engineer focused on systems integration, designing and consuming REST APIs and moving data reliably between applications — the core of the role you describe.

At Acme Corp, a B2B supply-chain and logistics SaaS company, I build REST APIs in C#/.NET and Python/FastAPI that integrate external carrier and ERP systems into a shipment-tracking platform, backed by PostgreSQL schemas and analytical SQL for customer reporting. Earlier, at Globex Pty Ltd, an insurance claims-processing platform, I developed C#/.NET REST endpoints for the claims-intake service and wrote SQL Server stored procedures and queries for regulatory reporting.

Across both roles I have owned CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments — GitHub Actions and Azure at Acme Corp, Azure DevOps at Globex Pty Ltd — and taken part in production incident response. This matches your desirable criteria around Docker, CI/CD ownership, and Azure exposure, and I am keen to deepen my experience with a dedicated iPaaS platform and healthcare interoperability standards on your delivery team.
I have full working rights in Australia and would welcome the chance to discuss how my integration background fits this role. Thank you for your consideration.
